title: 第9章 围堵
slug: 穿梭时空的侠客全本免费-穿梭时空的侠客最新章节列表
content_zh:
原电影里沈炼误杀凌云恺时她就抽空子跑了，这次陈浩击杀了凌云恺她当时没机会跑掉，今天还是跑掉了！
北斋跑掉对陈浩来说也算是个利好的消息，起码又回复到了原来的剧情。
沈炼恼怒道：“都怪我，昨天我就不该出手救她，若不是如此也不会杀了凌云恺！”
“大哥喜欢她？”陈浩不接沈炼的话茬，这货摆明了口是心非。
“我......”沈炼的脸唰下子就红了，最终还是在陈浩的注视下点了下头。
陈浩笑道：“呵呵，既然大哥喜欢，那这么做就是值得的。”
“唉！只是连累了长青你了！”沈炼叹息道。
陈浩洒脱的道：“我无所谓，这世上我就大哥一个亲人了，哪有什么连累！”
“是大哥见外了！”沈炼走到陈浩面前重重拍了两下他的肩膀，颇有些愧疚的说道：“好兄弟！”
“哦，对了，昨天你杀凌云恺时用的是什么火器，为兄为何从未见过？”
沈炼肯定不会说那是21世纪的手枪，于是乎继续编瞎话道：“那是红毛鬼的国家制造的火枪，我从广州回来的时候带了一把！”
“哦，原来是红毛鬼的火枪，威力好大！”沈炼还真信了，他毕竟没去过西方，陈浩来之前他甚至都没听过几次关于西方的事情，说起来他还是挺信任陈浩的，连陈浩昨晚是因为担心他才去的北斋小院都相信！若是换成另一个人，他绝不会这般轻易相信。
“大哥以后要小心点，裴纶今日找我喝酒了！”陈浩不想聊手枪的事，他将话题扯到了裴纶身上。
裴纶？沈炼脸色多了一丝凝重，他道：“裴纶就是南镇抚司专门派来调查凌云恺被杀案件的，他怎么会找你喝酒？”
“凌云恺的事情，大哥怎么处理的？”陈浩道：“裴纶表面上是感谢我拉了殷澄一把，实则是想从我身上问询你的事情，大概、也许、他已经认定了你是杀了凌云恺的凶手！”
“你走之后，我便把可能暴露的问题都处理了，凌云恺的无常簿也被我烧了，随后我将北斋安排在了一个偏僻的小院里！”沈炼表情严峻，沉思了一会后，肯定的语气说道：“如果有地方引起了裴纶的注意，那只有两点，一是无常簿，除了锦衣卫内部的人，很少有人会破坏他人的无常簿，第二就是前天晚上我和凌云恺在金陵楼发生的争执！”
“你是怎么跟路千户汇报的？”陈浩又道。
沈炼道：“我说有人救走了北斋，杀了凌云恺，而凶手使用的是火器！”
陈浩点了点头，他当然知道裴纶就是因为这两点怀疑的沈炼。
原电影里因为沈炼逼死了殷澄，裴纶才处处针对沈炼，在陈浩看来也不尽然，就算沈炼没有逼死殷澄裴纶还是会调查沈炼，无关其他，只关他的个人前途，找到杀死魏忠贤外甥的凶手可是个不小的功劳。

一道利箭划破了寂静的夜空，钉在了沈炼不远处的房门上。
“谁？”陈浩和沈炼立时握紧了绣春刀。
“有张纸。”沈炼急忙拔下了弓箭，只见那张纸上写着：“大明律，杀锦衣卫者，罪同谋逆，当夷三族，子时三刻，西山云溪坡。”
沈炼看后面色铁青，随手递给了陈浩，他装模作样的看了一眼，神情也变得很凝重，心里却替沈炼悲哀。
这肯定是北斋跑掉后，把陈浩杀凌云恺的事情通过丁白缨告诉了朱由检，而朱由检则想利用沈炼杀凌云恺的把柄、还有北斋的安危胁迫沈炼去烧掉案牍库，沈炼至始至终都跟个傻子似的，为了救回北斋，被朱由检他们耍的团团转，却不知北斋是朱由检的妞。
这沈炼平时那么精明，遇到女人就成了彻头彻尾的傻子！
“走，我们去云溪坡，别忘了拿着你的西洋火枪！”
沈炼这时候倒是表现的很干脆，还不忘提醒陈浩拿着手枪。
云溪坡在京城西面，离沈炼的家不算近，两兄弟走到地方时已是子时四刻，大概晚上十一点半左右。
云溪坡是一个竹林，本身环境就阴暗，在夜里更是一片漆黑，沈炼和陈浩进了竹林后只能缓慢走动，提防着会不会被人埋伏。
忽然沈炼抬手指了下前方，陈浩放眼望去有一个人影正坐在不远处的石头上，二人对视了一眼缓缓靠近。
“就是你吗？”距离那道人影还有五六米的时候，沈炼开口问道。

content_en:
In the original movie, when Shen Lian accidentally killed Ling Yunkai, she took the opportunity to run away. This time when Chen Hao killed Ling Yunkai, she had no chance to run away, but she still ran away today!
Beizhai's running away is good news for Chen Hao, at least it returns to the original plot.
Shen Lian said angrily: "It's all my fault. I shouldn't have rescued her yesterday. If not, I wouldn't have killed Ling Yunkai!"
"Brother likes her?" Chen Hao didn't answer Shen Lian's words. This guy showed his duplicity.
"I..." Shen Lian's face suddenly turned red, and he finally nodded under Chen Hao's gaze.
Chen Hao smiled and said: "Haha, since big brother likes it, then it is worth it."
"Oh! I just hurt you, Changqing!" Shen Lian sighed.
Chen Hao said calmly: "I don't care, my eldest brother is my only relative in this world, so there's no way I'll be involved!"
"It's eldest brother who's cheating!" Shen Lian walked up to Chen Hao and patted his shoulder twice, and said with some guilt: "Good brother!"
"Oh, by the way, what kind of firearm did you use when you killed Ling Yunkai yesterday? Why have you never seen it before?"
Shen Lian would definitely not say that it was a pistol of the 21st century, so he continued to make up lies: "That is a musket made in the country of the red-haired ghost. I brought one with me when I came back from Guangzhou!"
"Oh, it turns out to be the red-haired ghost's musket, so powerful!" Shen Lian really believed it. After all, he had never been to the West. He had never even heard about the West a few times before Chen Hao came. Speaking of which, he quite trusted Chen Hao. Even Beizhai Courtyard, where Chen Hao went to because he was worried about him last night, believed it! If it were another person, he would never believe it so easily.
"Brother, be careful in the future. Pei Lun came to drink with me today!" Chen Hao didn't want to talk about the pistol, so he brought the topic to Pei Lun.
Pei Lun? Shen Lian's face became more solemn, and he said: "Pei Lun was specially sent by Nanzhen Fusi to investigate the murder case of Ling Yunkai. Why would he ask you to drink?"
"How did eldest brother handle Ling Yunkai's matter?" Chen Hao said: "Pei Lun was thanking me for helping Yin Cheng, but in fact he wanted to ask me about you. Probably, maybe, he has already identified you as the murderer of Ling Yunkai!"
"After you left, I dealt with all the problems that may have been exposed. I also burned Ling Yunkai's Impermanence Book, and then I arranged Beizhai in a remote courtyard!" Shen Lian looked serious, and after thinking for a while, he said in a positive tone : "If there is anything that caught Pei Lun's attention, there are only two points. One is the Wuchang Book. Except for people within Jinyiwei, few people will destroy other people's Wuchang Book. The second is the dispute between Ling Yunkai and I at Jinling Tower the night before yesterday!"
"How did you report to Lu Qianhu?" Chen Hao asked again.
Shen Lian said: "I said someone rescued Beizhai and killed Ling Yunkai, and the murderer used firearms!"
Chen Hao nodded. Of course he knew that Pei Lun was Shen Lian who was suspicious of these two points.
In the original movie, because Shen Lian forced Yin Cheng to death, Pei Lun targeted Shen Lian everywhere. In Chen Hao's view, this is not the case. Even if Shen Lian did not force Yin Cheng to death, Pei Lun would still investigate Shen Lian. It has nothing to do with anything else but his personal future. Finding the murderer of Wei Zhongxian's nephew is a big achievement.
A sharp arrow pierced the silent night sky and nailed the door not far from Shen Lian.
"Who?" Chen Hao and Shen Lian immediately grasped the Xiuchundao.
"There is a piece of paper." Shen Lian hurriedly pulled out his bow and arrow, and saw what was written on the piece of paper: "Da Ming Law, killing the Jinyi guards is guilty of conspiracy to commit rebellion. The three tribes of Dangyi, at three o'clock in the day, on the Yunxi slope of Xishan Mountain."
Shen Lian looked ashen behind, and handed it to Chen Hao casually. He glanced at it pretendingly, and his expression became serious, but he felt sad for Shen Lian in his heart.
This must be because after Beizhai ran away, he told Zhu Youjian about Chen Hao's killing of Ling Yunkai through Ding Baiying, and Zhu YoujianYoujian wanted to use Shen Lian's excuse to kill Ling Yunkai and Beizhai's safety to coerce Shen Lian to burn the archives. Shen Lian acted like a fool from beginning to end. In order to save Beizhai, he was tricked by Zhu Youjian and others, but he didn't know that Beizhai was Zhu Youjian's girl.
This Shen Lian is usually so shrewd, but when he meets a woman, he becomes a complete fool!
"Let's go to Yunxi Slope, don't forget to take your Western musket!"
Shen Lian behaved very straightforwardly at this time, and did not forget to remind Chen Hao to hold the pistol.
Yunxi Slope is in the west of the capital, not close to Shen Lian's home. It was already four o'clock in the morning when the two brothers arrived, probably around 11:30 p.m.
Yunxi Slope is a bamboo forest. The environment itself is dark, and it is even darker at night. After entering the bamboo forest, Shen Lian and Chen Hao could only walk slowly, wary of being ambushed.
Suddenly Shen Lian raised his finger and pointed forward. Chen Hao looked around and saw a figure sitting on a stone not far away. The two looked at each other and slowly approached.
"Is that you?" Shen Lian asked when he was still five or six meters away from the figure.
